description: An archived set of PyTorch notebooks hand-implementing neural-network and attention experiments from primitives.
scope_audience: README defines the scope as a 2021–2022 study/reference archive, not a library. Readers may inspect individual notebooks, but many need CUDA, machine-local paths or assets that are not included.

creativity.reason: The inspected notebook implements a small self-attention blend, but README frames the set as hand-rolling familiar neural-network primitives; novelty is not established.

current_usefulness.reason: Some notebooks can be read as study material, but there is no supported project entrypoint and many cells depend on absent assets, data or deprecated APIs.

expected_usefulness.reason: Preserved examples can offer narrow historical learning value; no current package, dataset or future research scope is stated.

impl_progress.reason: SelfAttentionNn has an actual gated blend implementation, but the archive has no reproducible dataset, tests or integrated experiment acceptance.

presentability.reason: README openly explains limitations and redaction, yet roughly one-third duplicate/dead-end notebooks and many local assumptions make navigation and use difficult.

delivery_likelihood.reason: The declared archive is already complete as an archival study set; no unfinished product deliverable is promised.
